newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent lower, weighed down by weak NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent lower, weighed down by weak NYMEX.

text.p: September Brent futures were lower in late trading on Friday, dragged down by a weak NYMEX lacking the support of gasoline.
September Brent was last traded at $18.78 per barrel, down 16 cents from London overnight.
NYMEX crudes were last traded on ACCESS at $20.04 per barrel, down 10 cents from New York.
A major plank of crude support was killed off overnight with the expiry of the August gasoline futures contract on NYMEX.
The contract tumbled 2.06 cents per gallon to 67.84 cents as speculators who had rode the rally bailed out.
The sentiment spilled over into ACCESS trading and sent the September contract lower. It was last traded at 62.55, down 0.25 from New York.
Brokers said focus would now shift back to Iraq and the prospect of a flood of crude exports in August.
The United Nations said overnight it expected to give Iraq's aid distribution plan the green light early next week.
